source: But I guess… it’s not as hard as I thought it would be. Having you here is really encouraging.
translation: 不过我想……其实也没有我以为的那么难。有你在这里，真的让我很受鼓舞。

source: Well, I’ll be honest… your decision really relieved me! I was worried you’d miss out on this amazing chance.
translation: 嗯，我得说实话……你的决定真的让我松了口气！我还担心你会错过这个绝佳的机会。

source: I’m glad you were able to see how much potential you have, Aiden
translation: 我很高兴你终于看到了自己的潜力有多大，Aiden。

source: You deserve it and I promise you it’s going to be all good from here!
translation: 你值得拥有这一切，我向你保证，接下来一定会一切顺利！

source: Thanks a lot for changing my mind, Yoshi. I won’t let you down…!
translation: 多谢你改变了我的想法，Yoshi。我不会让你失望的……！

source: {i}Aiden and I left the office and told everyone his big news. Everyone was excited for him, but Aiden insisted he wanted to focus on finishing the project for now.{/i}
translation: {i}我和Aiden离开办公室，把他的好消息告诉了大家。大家都为他感到高兴，但Aiden坚持说现在想先专心完成项目。{/i}

source: {i}Everyone worked hard for the next few months, and I did my best to help Aiden get ready for his schooling once the work was done.{/i}
translation: {i}接下来的几个月里，大家都努力工作；等项目完成后，我也尽我所能帮助Aiden为入学做准备。{/i}

source: {i}Before long, the snow started to thaw, and the project was complete.{/i}
translation: {i}没过多久，积雪开始融化，项目也完成了。{/i}

source: I’m doubting my choice to be here… I’m doubting my choice to hold on to you as well…
translation: 我开始怀疑自己来这里的选择……也开始怀疑自己坚持和你在一起的选择……

source: A-Are you… breaking up with me, Aiden…?
translation: 你、你是要和我分手吗，Aiden……？

source: Ever since I was young, I've waited for the chance to be with you, Yoshi...
translation: 从我小时候起，我就一直等着有机会和你在一起，Yoshi……

source: I’ve been waiting all my life, and when I got a taste of it… not even for a year… you let me go.
translation: 我等了一辈子，终于尝到了和你在一起的滋味……可还不到一年……你就放开了我。

source: It’s reached a point where it’s affecting my life yet again…
translation: 事情已经发展到再次影响我生活的地步……

source: I’m not doing well, and I push people around me away because I keep comparing them to you and everyone at Camp Buddy.
translation: 我过得很不好，还会因为不断拿身边的人和你、以及 Camp Buddy 的大家比较，而把他们推开。

source: A-Aiden…! I’m sorry! Please let me make this right!
translation: 对、对不起，Aiden……！请让我弥补这一切！

source: It’s not your fault, I made some mistakes too. Maybe I’m really just not cut out for having a good life after all…
translation: 这不是你的错，我也犯过一些错误。也许我真的不配拥有美好的人生……

source: I-I’ll drop everything I’m doing right now! Let me fight for us!
translation: 我、我现在就放下手头的一切！让我为我们的未来努力争取吧！

source: N-No, Yoshi, I’m not asking you… I’ve made up my mind already.
translation: 不、不是的，Yoshi，我不是在要求你……我已经下定决心了。

source: I… want to make a choice for myself once and for all… I’m tired of going with the flow…
translation: 我……想彻底为自己做一次选择……我厌倦了随波逐流……

source: So, please Yoshi… Just set me free…
translation: 所以，求你了，Yoshi……放我自由吧……

source: Goodbye… Yoshi…
translation: 再见……Yoshi……

source: {i}After that call, I couldn’t contact him anymore.{/i}
translation: {i}那通电话之后，我再也无法联系到他了。{/i}

source: {i}A year later, Aiden and I had remained out of touch until I received some news.{/i}
translation: {i}一年后，Aiden和我一直没有联系，直到我收到了一些消息。{/i}

source: {i}Aiden finally became a professional chef, and was traveling the world enjoying his newfound passion.{/i}
translation: {i}Aiden终于成为了一名专业厨师，带着这份全新的热情周游世界。{/i}

source: {i}Maybe this was meant to happen after all - he reached his dreams at the cost of the love we once had for each other…{/i}
translation: {i}也许这一切终究是命中注定的——他实现了自己的梦想，却付出了我们曾经相爱的代价……{/i}
